title: MARKETPLACE PASS AND REALMS PLUS: AUGUST 2026
author: James Nouch
imageAltText: Minecraft Marketplace Pass promotional image highlighting featured content packs including Alcraft 1.2 Update and Huggy & Friends Add-On.
description: August brings a packed lineup for Minecraft Marketplace Pass and Realms Plus, with everything from the hardcore survival challenge of RLCraft Bedrock Edition to creative building, automation, and cozy living. Explore new adventures with add-ons like Huggy & Friends, Warpstones, and Auto Factory, transform your worlds with the medieval-inspired Excalibur texture pack, and customize your character with fresh skins, mermaid makeovers, and spooky skeleton-themed cosmetics. Whether you're battling for survival, building dream homes, expanding your farms, or simply collecting new ways to play, this month’s collection is overflowing with content for every kind of Minecraft player.

blocks.source_text: August has come around again, the sun is shining, and I have recently reconnected with a figure from my past. In other words, everything is happening exactly like that mysterious palm reader told me that it would.
blocks.translated_text:
八月又到了，阳光明媚，我最近又与过去的某个人取得了联系。换句话说，一切都正如那位神秘的手相师所言的那样发生着。」 wrap_up>

在欧洲，Minecraft玩家群体似乎也对即将到来的更新感到非常兴奋。他们通过各种论坛和社交媒体分享着他们的期待和猜测，其中一些内容几乎就像是官方更新日志的预览。这些玩家的语言和表达方式展示了他们对游戏的热情和对新内容的渴望。整体来看，这次欧洲玩家的反馈表明，他们对接下来的更新充满了期待和好奇。

```的和解读。以下是翻译后的内容：`[{

blocks.source_text: Believe me, I was sceptical, but this amazing clairvoyant also told me that a fresh cavalcade of mini games, add-ons, texture packs, and skins would be available for Marketplace Pass and Realms Plus subscribers this very month. What's that? She was right again! Woah!
blocks.translated_text: 相信我，我一开始很怀疑，但这位惊人的灵媒还告诉我，这个月 Marketplace Pass 和 Realms Plus 的订阅者将能够获得一系列新的小游戏、插件、纹理包和皮肤。你猜怎么着？她又说对了！哇！

blocks.source_text: I'm sure that you, like me, are absolutely reeling from the astonishing accuracy of this mall palmist's predictive powers. Let's both try to maintain a veneer of composure for just long enough to see what's new on Marketplace Pass this month.
blocks.translated_text: 我敢肯定，你和我一样，对这位“手相师”的预测能力感到震惊。让我们都试着保持冷静，看看这个月 Marketplace Pass 上有什么新内容吧。

blocks.source_text: MINI GAMES
blocks.translated_text: 小游戏（Mini Games）

blocks.source_text: Some games need no introduction, and yet my cold-hearted editors insist that I write them anyway, even though I'm extremely tired. So, here's [RLCraft Bedrock Edition V1.2 by Honeyfrost](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/honeyfrost/rlcraft-bedrock-edition-1.2/062d87b7-819a-437d-9493-2a6603449220), widely regarded as one of the most accomplished - and hardcore - survival experiences around. Expect a transformative experience in which you'll find yourself working doubly hard to gather even the most basic materials, all while fending off attacks from some seriously scary mobs throughout the day and night. Adapt to these harsh new realities and you'll uncover a deep levelling system and incredibly satisfying progression. If you can survive long enough to see it, I mean.
blocks.translated_text: 有些游戏无需介绍，但我这些冷酷无情的编辑人员却坚持让我写评论——尽管我已经累坏了。那么，这就是 [Honeyfrost 制作的 RLCraft Bedrock Edition V1.2](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/honeyfrost/rlcraft-bedrock-edition-1.2/062d87b7-819a-437d-9493-2a6603449220)。这款游戏被广泛认为是最出色的、最具硬核挑战性的生存游戏之一。在游戏中，你需要拼命收集最基本的材料，同时还要抵御各种可怕的怪物所带来的攻击，无论是白天还是黑夜。只有适应这些严酷的现实，你才能发现其深层次的等级系统和令人满足的待机机制。不过，前提是你得活得够久才行……

blocks.source_text: Ever wished you could click your fingers and watch skyscrapers, restaurants, and bustling stores burst into existence before your very eyes? Well, [Craftable City by Lifeboat](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/lifeboat/craftable-city/98033cf2-6d88-48e6-997b-49d97cfaa519) has helped me with the instant-skyscraper part, but according to a note from the developers they're unable to teach me how to click my fingers. The sight of my gleaming urban playground brings me comfort while I soundlessly slap my thumbs together.
blocks.translated_text: 有没有想过，只要轻轻一捻手指，高楼大厦、餐馆和热闹的商店就能在你眼前瞬间出现？[Lifeboat 的「Craftable City」](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/lifeboat/craftable-city/98033cf2-6d88-48e6-997b-49d97cfaa519)帮我实现了高楼大厦的瞬间生成功能，不过据开发者说，他们没法教会我如何“捻手指”。虽然这个闪闪发光的城市“游乐场”让我感到很满足，但我只能默默地用拇指相互碰撞来代替真正的捻手指动作……

blocks.source_text: The pale garden biome has been scaring even the most intrepid explorers (e.g. me, and people exactly like me) since 2024, but it's never looked quite so fabulous. That's all thanks to [Pale Garden House by Overtales Studio](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/overtales-studio/pale-garden-house/cd873272-c416-489f-8a6f-d59b4452d28e), which adds a heap of stylish yet cozy buildings to this otherwise spooky biome. Sure, the outdoors may still be packed with creakings trying to headbutt me into the ground, but who cares when I get to live in a modish (and fully furnished) estate.
blocks.translated_text: 自2024年以来，这个被称为“苍白花园”的生物群落就一直让最勇敢的探险家们（比如我和像我这样的人）感到恐惧，但这次它看起来却异常壮观。这都要归功于[Overtales Studio开发的《苍白花园房屋》（Pale Garden House）](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/overtales-studio/pale-garden-house/cd873272-c416-489f-8a6f-d59b4452d28e)——这款mod为这个原本阴森的生物群落增添了许多时尚又舒适的建筑。虽然户外依然充满了试图把我撞向地面的“嘎吱作响的怪物”，但当我能够住在这样一个时尚且设施齐全的宅邸里时，谁还在乎那些呢？

blocks.source_text: Yet more luxury awaits in [Cozy Camp House by ThunderAy](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/thunderay/cozy-camp-house/f0bfaf4f-362b-4a06-a548-2c599dda18c7). Like a French lumberjack or a bear in an exquisitely tailored suit, this countryside home positively screams rustic chic. An outdoor pool, an elegant living area, and a dedicated target practice area complete the sumptuous package. C'est magnifique.
blocks.translated_text: [ThunderAy 的舒适度假屋](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/thunderay/cozy-camp-house/f0bfaf4f-362b-4a06-a548-2c599dda18c7)中还有更多奢华元素等待您发现。这座乡村住宅宛如一位穿着精致西装的法国伐木工人或一只熊，完美诠释了“ rustic chic ”（乡村时尚）的风格。户外游泳池、优雅的起居区以及专用的射击练习场构成了这个豪华住宅的完整配置。真是美极了！

blocks.source_text: And then there's [Modern Mansion by Dodo Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/dodo-studios/modern-mansion/f2dac2ec-11cb-4499-b9e8-b66a57b93a23), which is the perfect tonic for those of us recovering from being repeatedly pulverised in RLCraft. Relax and unwind in a giant mansion packed with tasteful home furnishings, before taking a dip in the gorgeous multi-level swimming pool. All while trying not to dwell on how frightening and fast and weird-looking that giant scorpion was in RLCraft.
blocks.translated_text: [Dodo Studios 设计的现代豪宅](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/dodo-studios/modern-mansion/f2dac2ec-11cb-4499-b9e8-b66a57b93a23)则是那些在 RLCraft 游戏中屡次遭受重创的玩家们的理想之选。在这座充满精美家居装饰的庞大豪宅中放松身心，然后去美丽的多层游泳池里畅游一番吧。不过在享受这一切的同时，还是别再去想那个巨大蝎子有多可怕、速度有多快，长得有多怪异吧……

blocks.source_text: ADD-ONS
blocks.translated_text: 附加内容（ADD-ONS）

blocks.source_text: When I think about friends, I think about: fun, laughter, and lying on my back in a rowboat while we take turns saying what shapes we see in the clouds. Now, after spending some time with [Huggy & Friends Add-on by Spark Universe](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/spark-universe/huggy--friends-add--on/30d1852c-d8a5-4e29-8631-bc14d96d35f2), I think about: fear, running, teeth, they're going to catch me, I can't get away, and teeth again. Try it for yourself if you fancy facing off against the likes of Huggy Wuggy, Mommy Long Leg, and The Doctor. Just don't say I didn't warn you.
blocks.translated_text: 当我想到朋友时，我会想到：乐趣、 laughter（笑声），还有我们躺在小船上，轮流说我们在云朵中看到了什么形状。然而，在使用了 [Spark Universe 的 Huggy & Friends 附加内容](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/spark-universe/huggy--friends-add--on/30d1852c-d8a5-4e29-8631-bc14d96d35f2) 之后，我想到的是：恐惧、奔跑、还有那些可怕的牙齿……它们随时可能会抓住我，我根本逃不掉。如果你也想体验与 Huggy Wuggy、Mommy Long Leg 和 The Doctor 等角色的对抗，不妨试试看。不过别怪我没提醒你哦。

blocks.source_text: Now I've thought about this a lot, and I've come to the conclusion that teleportation is the ultimate superpower. After all, super strength is pretty neat, but the Hulk still has to wait in line at the airport with his wallet and belt in one of those grey plastic trays. [Warpstones Add-on by Mythicus](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/mythicus/warpstones-add--on/d1b99d77-3c9e-43b7-8e74-211398bab679) is a multiplayer-friendly add-on that grants you the power to teleport yourself to preset locations - or your fellow players - in the blink of an eye. That can be hugely convenient, in much the same way I'd find it very convenient to be able to teleport to Rome whenever I crave a tiramisu.

Before we go any further, let me ask you a question: have you ever wished you could ctrl+z your own decisions? While the eggheads at MIT tell me that they "believe the imminent development of such technology is unlikely" and that I should "please stop sending such desperate emails about it", [Uncrafter+ 2.1 Add-on by Dalibu Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/dalibu-studios/uncrafter+-2.1-add--on/943a10e3-1001-4cae-a18b-5109dee023bd) is the next best thing. This powerful add-on lets you break crafted blocks back into their constituent parts. Excitingly, it works with a huge variety of other add-ons, allowing you to dismantle, disassemble, and otherwise undo whatever dubious crafting decisions you might have made.

Now here's a piece of advice. Whether we're talking about your paycheck, the friendships in your life, or the number of baguettes you can eat in a single sitting, I always say the same thing: more is better. [More Blocks 3.0 by RareLoot](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/rareloot/more-blocks-3.0/551f4979-eb59-42eb-9e01-7c6dddc53315) is yet more proof of this bulletproof wisdom, introducing more than 80 new blocks in over 1,000 texture variations. Perfect if you're planning an ambitious new build, or if you're a person who likes to ceaselessly boast about the number of blocks at their disposal. I'm the latter.
blocks.translated_text: 这里有一条建议：无论是你的工资、生活中的友谊，还是你一次能吃下多少条法棍面包，我总是说同一句话：越多越好。[RareLoot 出品的《More Blocks 3.0》（链接：https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/rareloot/more-blocks-3.0/551f4979-eb59-42eb-9e01-7c6dddc53315）再次证明了这一颠扑不破的真理，新增了 80 多种类型的方块，且每种方块都有超过 1000 种不同的纹理样式。如果你正在规划一个宏大的建筑项目，或者是个喜欢不停地炫耀自己拥有多少方块的人，这款产品绝对非常适合你。我就是属于后者。”

blocks.source_text: If, like me, you would rather climb into a taxi full of wolverines than spend so much as an hour engaged in hard, honest work, then boy-oh-boy do I have the add-on for you. [Auto Factory by Team Metallurgy](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/team-metallurgy/auto-factory/1e6bc964-e37d-44e9-b75b-ea7324de884d) is all about automation, offering a suite of labor-saving gadgetry to help you gather, move, and craft materials. With the help of conveyor belts, funnels, magnets, and more. you can create the redstone-compatible factory of your most Dickensian dreams.
blocks.translated_text: 如果你像我一样，宁愿爬上一辆塞满狼獾的出租车，也不愿花哪怕一个小时去做艰苦而诚实的劳动，那么我这里有非常适合你的插件。[Team Metallurgy 的 Auto Factory](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/team-metallurgy/auto-factory/1e6bc964-e37d-44e9-b75b-ea7324de884d) 就是为你准备的！这个插件完全致力于自动化，提供了一系列节省劳动力的工具，帮助你采集、搬运和制作材料。借助传送带、漏斗、磁铁等各种装置，你可以打造出属于你自己的、充满狄更斯风格的红石自动化工厂。

blocks.source_text: 5,000 is a really big number. Just ask my accountant, who tells me (often while crying) that it's the amount I need to earn every day for the next 30 years in order to "dig yourself out of the miserable financial hole you're in". It's also, coincidentally, the number of new blocks and furniture included in [Blocks Update by Radium Studio](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/radium-studio/blocks-update/20b8d758-89be-4975-8f21-4e696c791174). This block-stravaganza even plays nice with heaps of resource packs, making it a true boon for builders and interior designers.
blocks.translated_text: 5,000 这个数字可真不小。你问问我的会计就知道了，他经常（边哭着边）跟我说，这正是我未来30年里每天需要赚的钱，才能‘摆脱现在这糟糕的财务状况’。巧的是，这也是 [Radium Studio 的‘Blocks Update’](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/radium-studio/blocks-update/20b8d758-89be-4975-8f21-4e696c791174) 中新增的方块和家具的数量。这个充满创意的更新与各种资源包搭配使用效果极佳，对建筑师和室内设计师来说简直是福音。”    Zeus (Minecraft 游戏开发者) Dashboard, 甲级翻译专家.

blocks.source_text: Next up, nature! It's beautiful in the abstract, but the reality is that it's covered in mud and crawling with horrible bugs. That's why I've been using [Auto Farming Add-on by Block Perfect Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/block-perfect-studios/auto-farming-add--on/bfd4c18e-43c5-4709-94eb-73ca11ef25c9), which lets me grow productive crops inside pristine glass containers. Not only can these handsome vessels be used to create sprawling auto-harvesting farms, they also mean I don't suffer the indignity of getting soil under my freshly manicured fingernails. Ideal.
blocks.translated_text: 接下来是自然环境！从理论上讲，自然环境非常美丽，但实际上却是满是泥巴，还爬满了可怕的虫子。因此，我一直在使用 [Block Perfect Studios 开发的 Auto Farming Add-on](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/block-perfect-studios/auto-farming-add--on/bfd4c18e-43c5-4709-94eb-73ca11ef25c9)。这个插件让我能够在干净的玻璃容器里种植高产的作物。这些漂亮的容器不仅可以用来创建大规模的自动收获农场，还能让我免于让 freshly manicured fingernails（此处可能是个笔误，应该是“新修剪过的指甲”）沾上泥土的尴尬。真是完美！

blocks.source_text: Now I don't know about you, but the raw, physical effort of creating this article has unleashed a powerful hunger in me. Fortunately, [Food Expansion by Mine-North](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/mine--north/food-expansion/c83c084e-c0d3-4e40-afc6-2b09134ab6a6) is here to satisfy my appetite with a smorgasbord of culinary delights. There's dozens of new dishes to savor, along with new crops to cultivate and farming vehicles to drive around in a state of postprandial bliss.
blocks.translated_text: 现在我不知道你们怎么样，但撰写这篇文章所耗费的实际体力让我感到非常饥饿。幸运的是，[Mine-North 的食物扩展包](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/mine--north/food-expansion/c83c084e-c0d3-4e40-afc6-2b09134ab6a6)能满足我的食欲，提供各种美味的菜肴。这里有几十种新的菜肴可供品尝，还有新的农作物可以种植，以及 farming 车辆可以在饭后愉快的氛围中驾驶。”

blocks.source_text: TEXTURE PACKS
blocks.translated_text: 纹理包（Texture Packs）

meta.alt: Minecraft Excalibur promotional artwork showing a player with a glowing sword overlooking a vast medieval kingdom from a stone battlement.

blocks.source_text: Give your worlds a lick of crusty, medieval paint with [Excalibur by Syclone Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/syclone-studios/excalibur/bc756e7f-ab6d-4316-8a0f-9541c3bfe118), a texture pack that drapes everything from blocks to mobs to UI elements in ye olde finery. The overall effect is so thoroughly middle ages-y that I found myself forming strong opinions on feudalism, the three-field system of crop rotation, and the shifting balance between royal and baronial power. You know, medieval stuff.
blocks.translated_text: 用 [Syclone Studios 的 Excalibur](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/syclone-studios/excalibur/bc756e7f-ab6d-4316-8a0f-9541c3bfe118) 给你的世界增添一批古朴的中世纪风格元素吧！这个纹理包会将方块、怪物乃至用户界面元素都装饰成古代的风格。整个效果非常具有中世纪特色，以至于我不禁对封建制度、三田轮作法以及王权与贵族权力之间的平衡产生了浓厚的兴趣……总之，全是关于中世纪的各种话题哦。

blocks.source_text: Next up, we have a texture pack for the purists. Do you consider 16x16 textures the height of decadent excess? Do you long for simpler, more pared-back textures? Then look no further than [Vanilla 8x by Giggle Block Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/giggle-block-studios/vanilla-8x/e714ceb0-5c8e-4979-962c-40ca0a1d9aa9), which lends Minecraft a pleasingly streamlined, almost minimalist look - like a gorgeous work of modern art. But with more creepers.
blocks.translated_text: 接下来，我们为追求纯粹的游戏体验的玩家准备了一个纹理包。你们是否认为 16x16 的纹理过于繁琐、过于花哨？是否怀念更简洁、更素朴的纹理？那么不要犹豫，试试 [Giggle Block Studios 出品的 Vanilla 8x 纹理包](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/giggle-block-studios/vanilla-8x/e714ceb0-5c8e-4979-962c-40ca0a1d9aa9) 吧！这款纹理包让 Minecraft 看起来更加流畅、近乎极简主义风格——就像一件精美的现代艺术作品。不过，其中的爬行者（Creeper）模型也更加逼真了。

blocks.source_text: SKIN PACKS
blocks.translated_text: 皮肤包（SKIN PACKS）

blocks.source_text: Even when I find myself sick with rage (such as, hypothetically, when I'm disinvited from the annual [Minecraft.net](http://minecraft.net/) writers' pizza party for the crime of telling it like it is, and also for the crime of stealing unattended bags), I can always soothe myself by looking at some calming pastel tones. [Pastel Colors HD by Wonder](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/wonder/pastel-colors-hd/c622273c-af8b-4f77-824e-6bb62e2fc6ad) features eight pleasing pastel skins that I'm confident could pacify even a rampaging beast. My own testing was interrupted when I was bitten and kicked and trampled by said beast, but I remain committed to proving this theory.
blocks.translated_text: 即使我情绪激动到极点（比如，假设我因为说实话、或者因为偷了没人看管的包，而被 annual [Minecraft.net](http://minecraft.net/) 的作家披萨派对取消邀请），我也可以通过欣赏一些赏心悦目的淡彩色系图片来让自己平静下来。[Wonder 公司的 Pastel Colors HD](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/wonder/pastel-colors-hd/c622273c-af8b-4f77-824e-6bb62e2fc6ad) 包含八种令人愉悦的淡彩色皮肤，我相信它们甚至能让一头狂怒的野兽冷静下来。不过，我的实验被那头野兽咬了、踢了、还踩了我，所以没能继续完成……但我仍然坚信这一理论。

blocks.source_text: Ever wished that half of your body was replaced with that of a giant, muscular fish? Of course you have! [Mermaids Skin Pack by CupcakeBrianna](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/cupcakebrianna/mermaids-skin-pack/8c047de0-e4ed-4f4b-8ac0-b5ac342921a3) lets you live out your piscine dreams with 11 detailed mermaid skins in a variety of colors. Take to the water to live your best mermaid life! Or just waddle around on dry land to really freak those landlubbers out.
blocks.translated_text: 有没有想过自己的身体有一半能变成一条强壮的鱼？当然有！[CupcakeBrianna的美人鱼皮肤包](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/cupcakebrianna/mermaids-skin-pack/8c047de0-e4ed-4f4b-8ac0-b5ac342921a3)能让你实现这个梦想，包含11款细节丰富的美人鱼皮肤，有多种颜色可供选择。游泳时尽情享受美人鱼的生活吧！或者干脆在陆地上走动，好好吓吓那些陆地生物吧。

content:
August has come around again, the sun is shining, and I have recently reconnected with a figure from my past. In other words, everything is happening exactly like that mysterious palm reader told me that it would.

Believe me, I was sceptical, but this amazing clairvoyant also told me that a fresh cavalcade of mini games, add-ons, texture packs, and skins would be available for Marketplace Pass and Realms Plus subscribers this very month. What's that? She was right again! Woah!

I'm sure that you, like me, are absolutely reeling from the astonishing accuracy of this mall palmist's predictive powers. Let's both try to maintain a veneer of composure for just long enough to see what's new on Marketplace Pass this month.

MINI GAMES

Some games need no introduction, and yet my cold-hearted editors insist that I write them anyway, even though I'm extremely tired. So, here's [RLCraft Bedrock Edition V1.2 by Honeyfrost](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/honeyfrost/rlcraft-bedrock-edition-1.2/062d87b7-819a-437d-9493-2a6603449220), widely regarded as one of the most accomplished - and hardcore - survival experiences around. Expect a transformative experience in which you'll find yourself working doubly hard to gather even the most basic materials, all while fending off attacks from some seriously scary mobs throughout the day and night. Adapt to these harsh new realities and you'll uncover a deep levelling system and incredibly satisfying progression. If you can survive long enough to see it, I mean.

Ever wished you could click your fingers and watch skyscrapers, restaurants, and bustling stores burst into existence before your very eyes? Well, [Craftable City by Lifeboat](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/lifeboat/craftable-city/98033cf2-6d88-48e6-997b-49d97cfaa519) has helped me with the instant-skyscraper part, but according to a note from the developers they're unable to teach me how to click my fingers. The sight of my gleaming urban playground brings me comfort while I soundlessly slap my thumbs together.

The pale garden biome has been scaring even the most intrepid explorers (e.g. me, and people exactly like me) since 2024, but it's never looked quite so fabulous. That's all thanks to [Pale Garden House by Overtales Studio](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/overtales-studio/pale-garden-house/cd873272-c416-489f-8a6f-d59b4452d28e), which adds a heap of stylish yet cozy buildings to this otherwise spooky biome. Sure, the outdoors may still be packed with creakings trying to headbutt me into the ground, but who cares when I get to live in a modish (and fully furnished) estate.

Yet more luxury awaits in [Cozy Camp House by ThunderAy](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/thunderay/cozy-camp-house/f0bfaf4f-362b-4a06-a548-2c599dda18c7). Like a French lumberjack or a bear in an exquisitely tailored suit, this countryside home positively screams rustic chic. An outdoor pool, an elegant living area, and a dedicated target practice area complete the sumptuous package. C'est magnifique.

And then there's [Modern Mansion by Dodo Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/dodo-studios/modern-mansion/f2dac2ec-11cb-4499-b9e8-b66a57b93a23), which is the perfect tonic for those of us recovering from being repeatedly pulverised in RLCraft. Relax and unwind in a giant mansion packed with tasteful home furnishings, before taking a dip in the gorgeous multi-level swimming pool. All while trying not to dwell on how frightening and fast and weird-looking that giant scorpion was in RLCraft.

ADD-ONS

When I think about friends, I think about: fun, laughter, and lying on my back in a rowboat while we take turns saying what shapes we see in the clouds. Now, after spending some time with [Huggy & Friends Add-on by Spark Universe](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/spark-universe/huggy--friends-add--on/30d1852c-d8a5-4e29-8631-bc14d96d35f2), I think about: fear, running, teeth, they're going to catch me, I can't get away, and teeth again. Try it for yourself if you fancy facing off against the likes of Huggy Wuggy, Mommy Long Leg, and The Doctor. Just don't say I didn't warn you.

Now I've thought about this a lot, and I've come to the conclusion that teleportation is the ultimate superpower. After all, super strength is pretty neat, but the Hulk still has to wait in line at the airport with his wallet and belt in one of those grey plastic trays. [Warpstones Add-on by Mythicus](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/mythicus/warpstones-add--on/d1b99d77-3c9e-43b7-8e74-211398bab679) is a multiplayer-friendly add-on that grants you the power to teleport yourself to preset locations - or your fellow players - in the blink of an eye. That can be hugely convenient, in much the same way I'd find it very convenient to be able to teleport to Rome whenever I crave a tiramisu.

Before we go any further, let me ask you a question: have you ever wished you could ctrl+z your own decisions? While the eggheads at MIT tell me that they "believe the imminent development of such technology is unlikely" and that I should "please stop sending such desperate emails about it", [Uncrafter+ 2.1 Add-on by Dalibu Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/dalibu-studios/uncrafter+-2.1-add--on/943a10e3-1001-4cae-a18b-5109dee023bd) is the next best thing. This powerful add-on lets you break crafted blocks back into their constituent parts. Excitingly, it works with a huge variety of other add-ons, allowing you to dismantle, disassemble, and otherwise undo whatever dubious crafting decisions you might have made.

Now here's a piece of advice. Whether we're talking about your paycheck, the friendships in your life, or the number of baguettes you can eat in a single sitting, I always say the same thing: more is better. [More Blocks 3.0 by RareLoot](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/rareloot/more-blocks-3.0/551f4979-eb59-42eb-9e01-7c6dddc53315) is yet more proof of this bulletproof wisdom, introducing more than 80 new blocks in over 1,000 texture variations. Perfect if you're planning an ambitious new build, or if you're a person who likes to ceaselessly boast about the number of blocks at their disposal. I'm the latter.

If, like me, you would rather climb into a taxi full of wolverines than spend so much as an hour engaged in hard, honest work, then boy-oh-boy do I have the add-on for you. [Auto Factory by Team Metallurgy](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/team-metallurgy/auto-factory/1e6bc964-e37d-44e9-b75b-ea7324de884d) is all about automation, offering a suite of labor-saving gadgetry to help you gather, move, and craft materials. With the help of conveyor belts, funnels, magnets, and more. you can create the redstone-compatible factory of your most Dickensian dreams.

5,000 is a really big number. Just ask my accountant, who tells me (often while crying) that it's the amount I need to earn every day for the next 30 years in order to "dig yourself out of the miserable financial hole you're in". It's also, coincidentally, the number of new blocks and furniture included in [Blocks Update by Radium Studio](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/radium-studio/blocks-update/20b8d758-89be-4975-8f21-4e696c791174). This block-stravaganza even plays nice with heaps of resource packs, making it a true boon for builders and interior designers.

Next up, nature! It's beautiful in the abstract, but the reality is that it's covered in mud and crawling with horrible bugs. That's why I've been using [Auto Farming Add-on by Block Perfect Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/block-perfect-studios/auto-farming-add--on/bfd4c18e-43c5-4709-94eb-73ca11ef25c9), which lets me grow productive crops inside pristine glass containers. Not only can these handsome vessels be used to create sprawling auto-harvesting farms, they also mean I don't suffer the indignity of getting soil under my freshly manicured fingernails. Ideal.

Now I don't know about you, but the raw, physical effort of creating this article has unleashed a powerful hunger in me. Fortunately, [Food Expansion by Mine-North](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/mine--north/food-expansion/c83c084e-c0d3-4e40-afc6-2b09134ab6a6) is here to satisfy my appetite with a smorgasbord of culinary delights. There's dozens of new dishes to savor, along with new crops to cultivate and farming vehicles to drive around in a state of postprandial bliss.

TEXTURE PACKS

[IMAGE:Minecraft Excalibur promotional artwork showing a player with a glowing sword overlooking a vast medieval kingdom from a stone battlement.](https://www.minecraft.net/content/dam/minecraftnet/games/minecraft/marketplace/Marketplace_DotNet_Aug26_Excalibur_MarketingKeyArt.jpg)

Give your worlds a lick of crusty, medieval paint with [Excalibur by Syclone Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/syclone-studios/excalibur/bc756e7f-ab6d-4316-8a0f-9541c3bfe118), a texture pack that drapes everything from blocks to mobs to UI elements in ye olde finery. The overall effect is so thoroughly middle ages-y that I found myself forming strong opinions on feudalism, the three-field system of crop rotation, and the shifting balance between royal and baronial power. You know, medieval stuff.

Next up, we have a texture pack for the purists. Do you consider 16x16 textures the height of decadent excess? Do you long for simpler, more pared-back textures? Then look no further than [Vanilla 8x by Giggle Block Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/giggle-block-studios/vanilla-8x/e714ceb0-5c8e-4979-962c-40ca0a1d9aa9), which lends Minecraft a pleasingly streamlined, almost minimalist look - like a gorgeous work of modern art. But with more creepers.

SKIN PACKS

Even when I find myself sick with rage (such as, hypothetically, when I'm disinvited from the annual [Minecraft.net](http://minecraft.net/) writers' pizza party for the crime of telling it like it is, and also for the crime of stealing unattended bags), I can always soothe myself by looking at some calming pastel tones. [Pastel Colors HD by Wonder](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/wonder/pastel-colors-hd/c622273c-af8b-4f77-824e-6bb62e2fc6ad) features eight pleasing pastel skins that I'm confident could pacify even a rampaging beast. My own testing was interrupted when I was bitten and kicked and trampled by said beast, but I remain committed to proving this theory.

Ever wished that half of your body was replaced with that of a giant, muscular fish? Of course you have! [Mermaids Skin Pack by CupcakeBrianna](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/cupcakebrianna/mermaids-skin-pack/8c047de0-e4ed-4f4b-8ac0-b5ac342921a3) lets you live out your piscine dreams with 11 detailed mermaid skins in a variety of colors. Take to the water to live your best mermaid life! Or just waddle around on dry land to really freak those landlubbers out.

Next up, we have a skin pack so adventurous that it would scale the world's tallest mountains - if it wasn't cruelly held back by the fact that it's just downloadable software and doesn't have a physical form. Shed a tear, then, for [Adventurers by Gamefam](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/gamefam/adventurers/fe060ccb-2011-4251-b4f1-980dda3f98d0). It may never summit Everest, but it does feature eight bold, intrepid skins equipped with rugged outdoor gadgetry befitting their dauntless dispositions.

CHARACTER CREATOR ITEMS

[IMAGE:Minecraft Marketplace Pass promotional image featuring a skeletal-themed character skin with wings and glowing cyan accents.](https://www.minecraft.net/content/dam/minecraftnet/games/minecraft/marketplace/869dhutdf_Minecraft_RealmsPlus_August2026_.NET_1280x720.jpg)

The final items on our bumper list of treats making their way to Marketplace Pass this month are themed around the most frightening object known to humankind: the spooky skeleton. I'm sure you'll agree that it was very brave of me to even attempt to write about these Character Creator items, much less to assemble them in a gorgeously formatted bullet-point list.

● RGB Skeleton Head by CubeCraft Games

● Dark Scary Wings by Street Studios

● RGB Skeleton Pants by CubeCraft Games

● RGB Skeleton Top by CubeCraft Games

● Black Bold Glow Fire hands by Horizon Blocks

● Abyss Feet by Meraki

And there we have it: another month that is sure to go down in the history books principally for reasons relating to Minecraft Marketplace. I've never actually met a historian, but I assume that's what they're all up to, right?

Something in this list of goodies caught your eye? All you need to do is sign up to [Marketplace Pass](https://www.minecraft.net/marketplace/marketplace-pass) today to gain access to this treasure trove of mini games, add-ons, textures packs, and more. Or, if you're the sociable type, you could subscribe to [Realms Plus](https://www.minecraft.net/realms/bedrock) to get all this and an always-online server for you and up to 10 friends to stomp around in.

在欧洲，Minecraft玩家群体似乎也对即将到来的更新感到非常兴奋。他们通过各种论坛和社交媒体分享着他们的期待和猜测，其中一些内容几乎就像是官方更新日志的预览。这些玩家的语言和表达方式展示了他们对游戏的热情和对新内容的渴望。整体来看，这次欧洲玩家的反馈表明，他们对接下来的更新充满了期待和好奇。

```的和解读。以下是翻译后的内容：`[{ 相信我，我一开始很怀疑，但这位惊人的灵媒还告诉我，这个月 Marketplace Pass 和 Realms Plus 的订阅者将能够获得一系列新的小游戏、插件、纹理包和皮肤。你猜怎么着？她又说对了！哇！ 我敢肯定，你和我一样，对这位“手相师”的预测能力感到震惊。让我们都试着保持冷静，看看这个月 Marketplace Pass 上有什么新内容吧。 小游戏（Mini Games） 有些游戏无需介绍，但我这些冷酷无情的编辑人员却坚持让我写评论——尽管我已经累坏了。那么，这就是 [Honeyfrost 制作的 RLCraft Bedrock Edition V1.2](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/honeyfrost/rlcraft-bedrock-edition-1.2/062d87b7-819a-437d-9493-2a6603449220)。这款游戏被广泛认为是最出色的、最具硬核挑战性的生存游戏之一。在游戏中，你需要拼命收集最基本的材料，同时还要抵御各种可怕的怪物所带来的攻击，无论是白天还是黑夜。只有适应这些严酷的现实，你才能发现其深层次的等级系统和令人满足的待机机制。不过，前提是你得活得够久才行…… 有没有想过，只要轻轻一捻手指，高楼大厦、餐馆和热闹的商店就能在你眼前瞬间出现？[Lifeboat 的「Craftable City」](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/lifeboat/craftable-city/98033cf2-6d88-48e6-997b-49d97cfaa519)帮我实现了高楼大厦的瞬间生成功能，不过据开发者说，他们没法教会我如何“捻手指”。虽然这个闪闪发光的城市“游乐场”让我感到很满足，但我只能默默地用拇指相互碰撞来代替真正的捻手指动作…… 自2024年以来，这个被称为“苍白花园”的生物群落就一直让最勇敢的探险家们（比如我和像我这样的人）感到恐惧，但这次它看起来却异常壮观。这都要归功于[Overtales Studio开发的《苍白花园房屋》（Pale Garden House）](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/overtales-studio/pale-garden-house/cd873272-c416-489f-8a6f-d59b4452d28e)——这款mod为这个原本阴森的生物群落增添了许多时尚又舒适的建筑。虽然户外依然充满了试图把我撞向地面的“嘎吱作响的怪物”，但当我能够住在这样一个时尚且设施齐全的宅邸里时，谁还在乎那些呢？ [ThunderAy 的舒适度假屋](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/thunderay/cozy-camp-house/f0bfaf4f-362b-4a06-a548-2c599dda18c7)中还有更多奢华元素等待您发现。这座乡村住宅宛如一位穿着精致西装的法国伐木工人或一只熊，完美诠释了“ rustic chic ”（乡村时尚）的风格。户外游泳池、优雅的起居区以及专用的射击练习场构成了这个豪华住宅的完整配置。真是美极了！ [Dodo Studios 设计的现代豪宅](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/dodo-studios/modern-mansion/f2dac2ec-11cb-4499-b9e8-b66a57b93a23)则是那些在 RLCraft 游戏中屡次遭受重创的玩家们的理想之选。在这座充满精美家居装饰的庞大豪宅中放松身心，然后去美丽的多层游泳池里畅游一番吧。不过在享受这一切的同时，还是别再去想那个巨大蝎子有多可怕、速度有多快，长得有多怪异吧…… 附加内容（ADD-ONS） 当我想到朋友时，我会想到：乐趣、 laughter（笑声），还有我们躺在小船上，轮流说我们在云朵中看到了什么形状。然而，在使用了 [Spark Universe 的 Huggy & Friends 附加内容](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/spark-universe/huggy--friends-add--on/30d1852c-d8a5-4e29-8631-bc14d96d35f2) 之后，我想到的是：恐惧、奔跑、还有那些可怕的牙齿……它们随时可能会抓住我，我根本逃不掉。如果你也想体验与 Huggy Wuggy、Mommy Long Leg 和 The Doctor 等角色的对抗，不妨试试看。不过别怪我没提醒你哦。 这里有一条建议：无论是你的工资、生活中的友谊，还是你一次能吃下多少条法棍面包，我总是说同一句话：越多越好。[RareLoot 出品的《More Blocks 3.0》（链接：https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/rareloot/more-blocks-3.0/551f4979-eb59-42eb-9e01-7c6dddc53315）再次证明了这一颠扑不破的真理，新增了 80 多种类型的方块，且每种方块都有超过 1000
